Title: Romans 3:1-20 -  Lesson 4

TAKEAWAY
All people have sinned and stand guilty before God.



DIVISION 1 — NO DEFENSE (Romans 3:1–8)
Principle  God’s faithfulness leaves us no defense for our unfaithfulness.

Application Question  How has God been faithful to you, and how does this change the way you respond when you fail Him?


DIVISION 2 — NO RIGHTEOUSNESS (Romans 3:9–18)
Principle  Left to ourselves, sin rules us from the inside out.

Application Question  Where are you most tempted to underestimate how deeply sin affects you?



DIVISION 3 — NO ESCAPE (Romans 3:19–20)
Principle  The Law exposes our guilt and our need for a Savior.

Final Reflection Question  Considering how seriously God takes our sin, where have you become too casual about sin in your life?
